;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Basque conflict]]
**In [[Cambo-les-Bains]], [[France]], [[ETA (separatist group)|ETA]] performs its final act of dissolution in the presence of politicians such as [[Gerry Adams]], [[Jonathan Powell (Labour adviser)|Jonathan Powell]], [[Brian Currin]] and [[Cuauhtémoc Cárdenas]]. [https://politica.elpais.com/politica/2018/05/03/actualidad/1525349632_652141.html (''El País'')]
**[[Prime Minister of Spain|Spanish Prime Minister]] [[Mariano Rajoy]] reminds a crowd to remember the 853 victims of the conflict and reaffirms that there will be no impunity for the violence perpetrated by ETA during its 60-year history. [https://politica.elpais.com/politica/2018/05/04/actualidad/1525429865_138499.html (''El País'')]

;Arts and culture
*[[Nobel Prize in Literature]]
**The Nobel Prize in Literature 2018 is postponed to 2019 after [[Jean-Claude Arnault]], husband of the former [[Swedish Academy]] member [[Katarina Frostenson]], is accused of sexual assault, resulting in her resignation, and leaving the academy without a quorum. [https://www.theguardian.com/books/2018/may/04/nobel-prize-for-literature-2018-cancelled-after-sexual-assault-scandal (''The Guardian'')]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[2018 Hawaii earthquake]]
**A [[moment magnitude scale|magnitude]] 6.9 earthquake hits [[Hawaii]], the strongest in [[1975 Hawaii earthquake|over 40 years]], amid ongoing seismic and volcanic activity. [http://www.latimes.com/nation/la-na-hawaii-volcano-earthquake-20180504-story.html (''LA Times'')] [https://www.firstpost.com/world/hawaii-two-dead-28-injured-after-6-9-magnitude-earthquake-causes-eruption-in-kilauea-volcano-residents-flee-4456901.html (First Post)]
*[[2018 lower Puna eruption]]
**[[Hawaii]]an volcano [[Kīlauea]] begins erupting at the [[Leilani Estates, Hawaii|Leilani Estates]] subdivision, spurring a mandatory evacuation order of residents. [http://www.hawaiicounty.gov/active-alerts/volcanic-eruption-in-lower-puna-district-message-for-friday.html (County of Hawaii)] [https://volcanoes.usgs.gov/volcanoes/kilauea/status.html (HVO)]
*A heap of mining waste collapses at a [[jade]] mine in [[Kachin State]], [[Myanmar]], causing a [[landslide]] that kills at least 17 people. Six people are also left injured and an unknown number of people are missing. [https://apnews.com/4e598188626c46e78fa7b2ed7d97e861 (AP)] [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/news/asia/myanmar-jade-mine-slag-heap-collapse-kills-17-10202550 (Channel NewsAsia)]
*[[List of shipwrecks in 2018|Maritime incidents in 2018]]
**A [[Turkey|Turkish]] cargo ship collides with [[Greece|Greek]] warship [[Osprey 55-class gunboat|''Armatalos'']] off the coast of [[Lesbos]] in the [[Aegean Sea]]. The [[Hellenic Navy]] says the ship then retreated to Turkish waters without responding to radio messages. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2018/may/04/turkish-boats-collision-greek-warship-sparks-fears-hot-incident (''The Guardian'')]
;International relations
*[[2017–18 North Korea crisis]]
**[[North Korea–South Korea relations]]
***At 23:30 local time, [[North Korea]] changes its [[Time in North Korea|time zone]] to match [[South Korea]] ([[UTC+09:00]]) – a "first practical" impetus for [[Korean reunification]], says the official North Korean agency [[Korean Central News Agency|KCNA]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-asia-44010705 (BBC)]
**[[South Korea–United States relations]]
***[[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]] announces that he will meet [[President of South Korea|South Korean President]] [[Moon Jae-in]] on May 22. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-trump-moon/trump-south-koreas-moon-to-meet-at-white-house-on-may-22-idUSKBN1I52M9 (Reuters)]
*[[Second Cold War]]
**The [[United States Navy]] re-establishes the [[United States Second Fleet]], which was disbanded in 2011, citing recent heightened tensions between [[NATO]] and [[Russia]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-defense-navy-russia/with-an-eye-on-russia-u-s-navy-re-establishing-its-second-fleet-idUSKBN1I52CJ (Reuters)]

;Law and crime
*[[Animal welfare]]
**Fifty juvenile [[crocodiles]] are seized at [[Heathrow Airport]], [[London]], after officials discover that they were being kept in inhumane conditions. [https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-44006480 (BBC)]
*[[Abortion in the United States]]
**[[Iowa]] [[Governor of Iowa|Governor]] [[Kim Reynolds]] signs a bill into law which bans most [[abortion]]s in the state if a [[fetal heartbeat]] can be detected, or roughly after around six weeks into pregnancy. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-iowa-abortion/iowa-governor-signs-fetal-heartbeat-abortion-ban-into-law-idUSKBN1I52ID (Reuters)]
*[[Palestinian political violence|Terrorism in Israel]]
**An arson attack on a pile of hay bales in the [[Jordan Valley (Middle East)|Jordan Valley]] does hundreds of thousands of [[Shekel]]s of damage. Local authorities describe the attack as terrorist. [https://www.ynetnews.com/articles/0,7340,L-5251567,00.html (Ynetnews)]
;Science and technology
*[[Volcanology]]
**A new model suggests that [[supervolcano]] eruptions occur more often in regions being pulled by tectonics. [http://en.brinkwire.com/303509/when-will-the-next-supervolcano-erupt-new-model-suggests-it-depends-on-local-plate-tectonics/ (Brinkwire)]
*[[Physical cosmology]]
**Using recent data from the [[Gaia (spacecraft)|Gaia spacecraft]], the value of the [[Hubble's law|Hubble constant]] is determined to be {{val|73.52|1.62}}, which confirms a disagreement with other methods of measuring the constant with a confidence of 99.993%. [https://www.inquisitr.com/4885533/the-hubble-constant-study-finds-simpler-approach-to-measuring-how-fast-the-universe-is-expanding/ (Inquisitr)]

;Sports
*In [[baseball]], the [[Los Angeles Angels]]' [[Albert Pujols]] becomes the 32nd [[Major League Baseball]] player to reach [[3,000 hit club|3,000 career hits]]. [https://www.yahoo.com/sports/angels-slugger-albert-pujols-joins-3000-hit-club-033132860.html (Yahoo! Sports)]
